user.title: VDM10 intercom
user.description: Register this Home Assistant instance as a room station on the VDM10 SIP registrar (usually the main indoor unit). The doorbell rings this extension; the camera shows the outdoor station.

data.local_ip: This host's IP on the intercom VLAN
data.name: Display name (optional)

error.cannot_bind: Address not on this host or port already in use

answer_call.name: Answer call
answer_call.description: Answers the ringing VDM10 doorbell call (200 OK, audio established; mic stays muted until the talk control is used).

hangup_call.name: Hang up call
hangup_call.description: Declines the ringing call or hangs up the established call.
